note: Lexus runs Toyota's engines under Toyota's codes, so the figures here match the Toyota table; only the V6/V8 families it does not share are added. Daihatsu's DL and CL diesels were recorded as petrol, and its 1KR-FE and 1NR-FE are Toyota units. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: Toyota's 2.2 D-4D in the Lexus IS 220d / IS 200d, same figures as the Toyota table uses for it. 2AD-FHV was recorded as petrol.

The Lexus hybrid Atkinson-cycle engines (CT200h, IS300h, GS450h, RX450h, LS600h). Specified 0W-20; a heavier grade is withheld, and so is a hot-climate alternative, because the engine runs intermittently.
8AR-FTS 2.0 turbo (NX200t/NX300, IS200t, RX200t) and V35A-FTS 3.5 twin-turbo (LS500). Turbocharged direct injection specified 0W-20.
Lexus V8 and V10 (1UZ/2UZ/3UZ-FE, 1UR/2UR, 1LR-GUE in the LFA) — LS, GS, SC, IS-F, LX. Large sump; API SL/SM with no ACEA requirement.
Lexus V6 and the 2JZ straight-six (IS, GS, ES, RX, SC300). API SL/SM; no ACEA requirement, so the hot-climate alternative applies.

Daihatsu DL / DL51 / DL52 2.8 and CL / CL10 / CL11 / CL60 / CL61 1.0 diesels — Delta, Rocky, Charade. Recorded as petrol. Conventional 15W-40 for a pre-common-rail diesel; capacity is a family estimate.
Daihatsu petrol — the Toyota-built 1KR-FE and 1NR-FE plus Daihatsu's own K3-VE, EJ-VE, 3SZ-VE, HC-E and HD-E (Sirion, Terios, Cuore, Materia, Charade). Small sump.
Daihatsu's older 0.8/1.0 petrols (CB, CB20/22/23/60/61/80/90, ED20, CD) — Charade, Cuore, Move. Very small sump; capacity is a family estimate.
